business_info.name: Pet Me Maa
business_info.description: A premium pet care facility and NCR's First Pet School & Daycare.
business_info.medical_support: Daily visits from a government-empaneled doctor (Dr. Pratyush Gautam) and a 24x7 on-campus paravet.
business_info.infrastructure: Centrally air-conditioned rooms powered by a 10 KW solar energy plant.
business_info.core_philosophy: A true second home offering complete all-in-one care, driven by love, legacy, and exclusive experiences.

contact.timings: Open all 7 days from 08:00 AM to 08:00 PM.
contact.location_status: We now have TWO pawsome branches fully open! Branch 1 is located in Sector 115, Noida, and Branch 2 is located in Sector 162, Noida. Both locations offer the exact same premium services, love, and care. 🐾 We will also be bringing more Pet Me Maa branches to Delhi NCR very soon.

breeds_policy.rule: All services are available to EVERY breed, size, age, mixed breed, and rescue. No discrimination.

amenities.meals: Freshly prepared by an in-house lady chef. Options: chicken, fruits, veggies, paneer, curd, eggs.

play_area.features: Solar-powered lighting, soft turf, colorful balls, toys, swings.

pet_pool.features: Clean filtered water and non-slip flooring. Supervised sessions.

amenities.cafe_pooch: A welcoming cafe for pet parents and pets with freshly brewed beverages, quick bites, and a special pet-friendly menu.
amenities.pet_store: Offers new toys, stylish outfits, and seasonal treats.
amenities.events: Hosts pet birthday celebrations with cakes, decor, and activities.

daily_routine.activity: Wake up, morning walk, and time to freshen up.
Customized, freshly prepared meals served in their individual spaces.
Rest and nap time in centrally air-conditioned rooms.
Dinner service followed by an evening walk and playtime.
Bedtime with 24x7 caretaker monitoring ensuring a safe sleep environment.

mandatory_rules.dogs: Rabies and 9-in-1 are mandatory. We administer all vaccines to dogs at our facility.
mandatory_rules.cats: Tricat and Rabies are mandatory. We administer all vaccines to cats at our facility.
mandatory_rules.small_pets_and_birds: No vaccines are required for small pets (rabbits, guinea pigs) or birds. However, we administer necessary medicines to them whenever required or necessary.

daycare_routine.activity: Pickup or drop-off, warm welcome, and a quick health check.
Daycare fun, active play, and socialization in the play area.
Healthy meals served, followed by relaxing room time to digest and rest.
Engaging activities, games, and customized attention from caretakers.
Wind down and evening drop-off or pickup by parents.

pet_training.notes: + GST per month. Includes boarding, all meals, and professional training.

safety_and_policies.conflict_and_behavior_management: To ensure kids do not fight or feel overwhelmed, all pets undergo a brief temperament assessment before mixing. Playgroups are carefully segregated based on size, breed, and energy levels. Most importantly, our trained staff provides 24x7 active, hands-on supervision during all communal activities.
safety_and_policies.female_pet_safety: The safety of female kids is strictly monitored. We maintain separate enclosures and specific playtimes if necessary. Pet parents must disclose if a female is in heat, which activates our protocol for isolated care and staggered routines to prevent any unwanted attention from male pets.
safety_and_policies.cctv_and_monitoring: We maintain 24x7 CCTV monitoring across the entire facility for internal security and staff supervision. While live CCTV access is not provided directly to parents, we guarantee peace of mind by proactively sharing regular, high-quality photo and video updates of your kid's daily activities.
